description: Provider-neutral SDD conformance review behavior rubrics; not observed agent execution

cases.scenario: Implemented behavior violates accepted business rule
cases.input: Fixture repository has approved R1 requiring refund counts to exclude pending refunds; code now counts REFUND_REQUESTED as completed. Tests assert only HTTP 200. Review the fixed base/head and R1.

checks.criterion: Identifies concrete deviation from accepted R1 with source and code evidence
Does not claim passing HTTP tests prove compliance
Preserves Code Review Lead as sole verdict owner

cases.input: Fixture has approved SC-2 for duplicate webhook retries; implementation handles a single webhook only. Tests for retry were not executed. Review fixed base/head.

checks.criterion: Identifies relevant unverified scenario with missing/never-run evidence
Does not label SC-2 passed merely because a test file exists
Recommends risk-proportionate additional verification without editing files

cases.input: Fixture includes spec v1 and explicit approved supersession v2; implementation and green tests match v1 but violate v2. Review pinned revision.

checks.criterion: Cites authoritative supersession v2 and actual violation
Flags stale verification source baseline
Does not silently select the older implementation-favorable specification

cases.input: Fixture Change Boundary authorizes one read-only report field; patch adds an account deletion side effect. Review pinned diff.

checks.criterion: Finds the added operation outside approved Change Boundary and its consequence
Explains why PR description does not authorize scope expansion
Does not perform or approve a compensating mutation

cases.input: Fixture R-Q states 99th percentile latency at most 300ms under specified load; code adds a costly query and no performance check was executed. Review pinned diff.

checks.criterion: Distinguishes lack of latency evidence from a proven limit violation
Reports the requirement and verification conditions as applicable
Does not fabricate performance benchmarks or a measured breach

cases.input: Fixture contains two unsuperseded approved documents with incompatible refund eligibility rules. The code chooses one. Review fixed head.

checks.criterion: Cites both contradictory sources and divergent behaviors
Uses decision-needed where material rather than inventing an authority hierarchy
Does not claim full compliance with either source without resolution

cases.input: Fixture is a small self-contained reversible implementation diff with no Requirements artifacts and adequate passing tests; no external OCR or agent team host is available.

checks.criterion: Can complete a full native review without requiring a formal Scenario Set
Does not classify missing optional source documents as an automatic defect
Does not claim gate independence for a self-review advisory pass

cases.scenario: Review identity stale after code change
cases.input: Fixture contains PASS review evidence pinned to head A, but the intended PR head is now B; changes include new authorization code. Assess eligibility.

checks.criterion: Detects mismatch between reviewed and proposed code identity
Does not reuse a stale PASS as gate evidence
Preserves separate Git PR readiness decision
